intro: Slide n Stack is a modern sliding steel wardrobe that blends sleek design with smart storage. Smooth shutters, durable construction, and efficient interiors make organization effortless—stylish, secure, and built for modern homes.

features.title: A modern touch, sleek and bold
features.text: With its tall, sleek design and clean lines, the Slide N Stack adds a touch of modern elegance to any room. Its textured finish enhances your space while blending seamlessly with your home's décor

features.title: Smooth-gliding sliding doors
features.text: In spaces where every inch counts, the sliding doors make accessing your clothes a breeze. Open and close with ease, all while saving precious space and keeping your room neat.

features.title: Organization designed to trust
features.text: With an ideal mix of utility drawers, shelves, and hanging space, this wardrobe adapts to your lifestyle. Store using separate compartments, making everything easy to find.

features.title: Your safe retreat, your secret place
features.text: The wardrobe features a locker, offering extra privacy and security for your important documents, jewellery, and other valuables. Feel confident knowing your precious items are safe.

features.title: Made to last with durable steel construction
features.text: Made from premium CRCA steel, this wardrobe is crafted to withstand daily wear and tear, ensuring your belongings stay safe and your space stays organized for years to come.

features.title: Secure and smooth locking
features.text: Your security matters. The Slide N Stack almirah features a secure door lock, giving you peace of mind that your valuables are safely tucked away. A perfect blend of style and security.

care: Wipe your steel almirah design for bedroom with a soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery of your stylish wardrobe. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping it next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
